$meta.note: This is the BRAND design system for the client's public website. It is NOT the smOS 'Cupertino' report design system (design-system/smos-design-system.css) — that one is for agency deliverables only. Do not mix them.

primary.role: Primary — 60% of color usage. CTAs, links, headings accents, trust/shield iconography.

primary-soft.role: Primary tint background (cards, badges, section bands).

secondary.role: Secondary — 30%. Gradients, decorative rules, leaf/wellness iconography. NOT for small text on white.

secondary-text.role: Accessible teal for TEXT on white (4.5:1+). Use instead of #20B2AA whenever teal must be read.

accent.role: Accent — 10%. Success ticks, energy bolt, 'verified' pills, progress. NOT for small text on white.

accent-text.role: Accessible green for TEXT/small icons on white.

inverse.role: Deep navy band for high-contrast dark sections (proof / final CTA).

brand.role: Hero wash, section headers, profile-style badges. Matches the social templates.

contrast_rules: Body text must hit WCAG AA 4.5:1; large text (>=24px or >=19px bold) must hit 3:1.
#20B2AA and #34C759 FAIL 4.5:1 on white. Never use them for body copy, small labels, or thin icons on white. Use --color-secondary-text / --color-accent-text instead.
#0066CC on #FFFFFF passes for text. #0066CC on #F5F5F7 also passes. #FFFFFF on #0066CC passes.
On the inverse navy band use --color-inverse-ink for body and #6FD8D1 / #6FE08F only for large display or graphics.
Never place white text on the brand gradient below 20px — the teal end drops under 3:1.
color.usage_ratio: 60 primary / 30 secondary / 10 accent — measured across the full page, not per section.

rules: Measure: 60–72ch max for body copy. Hero subhead capped at 46ch.
Numerals in stats/pricing use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.
Never set Poppins below 18px — it loses legibility. Sub-18px is always Inter.
Max two type sizes per card.

shadow.rule: Elevation is soft and low-contrast. Never use a hard drop shadow or a border+shadow together on the same element.

rules: Scroll reveals: opacity 0->1 + translateY(16px)->0 over 520ms ease-out, staggered 60ms, fired once via IntersectionObserver.
Every animation must be wrapped in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference).
No parallax, no auto-playing carousels, no scroll-jacking.
Hover: 200ms. Focus ring appears instantly (no transition).

focus.rule: :focus-visible on every interactive element. Never remove outlines without replacing them.
